name: 罰しない習慣
oneline: できた日を数える習慣記録。累計で植物が育つ
usage: Telegram で「筋トレした」「読書30分」のように送ると、Desk の習慣に入る
累計で育つ（10回で芽、30回で花、100回で木）。Desk の習慣画面の各カードにも出る
週に1回、育ち具合が届く
止めるときは、この tool.json の status を stopped にする
howToCheck: ターミナルで Desk のフォルダを開く
LIFEOS_DATA=/tmp/try07 python3 lifeos/bot/cli.py "読書30分" を実行する
記録しましたという返事と、植物の様子が出ることを見る
LIFEOS_DATA=/tmp/try07 python3 lifeos/07-habits/weekly.py --preview で週の文面を見る
何日か間を空けて Telegram で送っても、責める言葉が出ないことを見る（ボットの接続後）

_en.name: No-penalty habits
_en.oneline: A habit log that counts the days you did it. A plant grows with your total
usage: Send something like "did workout" or "reading 30 min" on Telegram, and it goes into Desk habits
It grows with your total (a sprout at 10, a flower at 30, a tree at 100). Each card on the Desk Habits screen shows it too
Once a week, you get an update on how it is growing
To stop it, set status in this tool.json to stopped
howToCheck: In Terminal, open the Desk folder
Check that the reply says it was recorded and shows the plant
See the weekly message with LIFEOS_DATA=/tmp/try07 python3 lifeos/07-habits/weekly.py --preview
Check that even after skipping a few days, Telegram replies never blame you (once the bot is connected)
